hero.name: K. Seenivasan
hero.professionalTitle: Senior Software Engineer | React & React Native Specialist
hero.tagline: Architecting high-performance cross-platform mobile apps & responsive web solutions with modern JavaScript, React, and React Native.
introduction: I am a results-driven Software Engineer with over 4 years of experience specializing in building resilient React Native mobile applications and modern React.js web platforms. I excel at translating complex client requirements into intuitive, fluid user experiences backed by clean architecture and optimized REST API integrations.

At MitrahSoft Software Solutions, I engineer scalable cross-platform software across automotive sales, real estate technology, and fitness domains. My technical domain focuses heavily on FlatList rendering optimization, state architecture, component reusability, and seamless Android deployment workflows.
keyStrengths: Robust REST API Integration & Async State Handling
Modular Component Architecture & Clean Code Practices

about.title: About Me
story: Hello! I'm Seenivasan K, a passionate Software Engineer based in Kovilpatti, Tamil Nadu. My journey in technology began during my Computer Science degree at G. Venkataswamy Naidu College, where I discovered my deep fascination for web engineering and mobile app architecture.

Over the past several years, I have worked professionally at MitrahSoft Software Solutions, taking complete ownership of frontend and mobile projects. I specialize in building performant mobile apps using React Native and sleek web applications using React.js.

When I am not crafting pixel-perfect interfaces or tuning application performance, you can find me reading books, exploring emerging open-source tech stacks, or refining my software engineering best practices.
